summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue event-calendar component but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub Releases, extracts and chmods it executable under the package directory, then invokes it to run `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line obfuscated script with a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW` push/shift loop), hex-mangled identifiers, and a large numeric constant table. The fetched Bun runtime is used specifically to execute this bundled opaque payload on every `npm install`, unconditionally. Neither the alternate-runtime fetch nor the payload's behavior is related to the stated purpose of a calendar UI component, and the payload's obfuscation prevents source-level inspection of what it does once Bun executes it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
